answer: Each identity must file one violet atlas page charting a distinct berth at the wharf, and stake a survey bond for it. The k-th page from one funder costs 4k, because the harbourmaster re-surveys every earlier berth before stamping the next, so N fakes cost 2N(N+1): 220 for 10, 20,200 for 100. Two pages charting one berth void both identities at the close.
